comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
Key takeaways. The model is excellent, and the license is unusual in that its royalty based. Its basically the unreal license. (He says unity, but a better comparison would be unreal since unity is largely subscription based)

Also, funded by UAE. Interesting times.

replies.author: StickiStickman
replies.body: The license basically makes it dead in the water though. The 40B parameters also means it cant be used on any consumer hardware.
